cbinstall.name: Yak Shaver CB Before Registration Email Verify
cbinstall.author: Yak Shaver
cbinstall.license: GNU General Public License version 2 or later
cbinstall.description: Pre-registration email verification gateway for CB user registration form.

param.name: gateway_enabled
param.label: Gateway Enabled
param.description: Enable or disable the pre-registration verification gateway.

param.name: verification_ttl_sec
param.label: Verification TTL (seconds)
param.description: Number of seconds a verification request remains valid after issuance.

param.name: code_length
param.label: Code Length
param.description: Numeric code length for new verification requests.

param.name: secret
param.label: Verification Secret
param.description: Secret used for verification code hashing as sha256(code + secret). Must be non-empty when gateway is enabled.

param.name: purge_after_days
param.label: Purge After (days)
param.description: Delete terminal rows (verified, cancelled, failed) older than this many days.

param.name: rl_ip_enabled
param.label: IP Limits Enabled
param.description: Enable or disable IP based send limiting.

param.name: rl_ip_short_window_min
param.label: IP Short Window (minutes)
param.description: Short IP limiter window length in minutes.

param.name: rl_ip_short_max
param.label: IP Short Window Max
param.description: Maximum sends per IP in the short window.

param.name: rl_ip_day_window_hours
param.label: IP Day Window (hours)
param.description: Day IP limiter window length in hours.

param.name: rl_ip_day_max
param.label: IP Day Window Max
param.description: Maximum sends per IP in the day window.

param.name: rl_email_enabled
param.label: Email Limits Enabled
param.description: Enable or disable email based send limiting.

param.name: rl_email_short_window_min
param.label: Email Short Window (minutes)
param.description: Short email limiter window length in minutes.

param.name: rl_email_short_max
param.label: Email Short Window Max
param.description: Maximum sends per email in the short window.

param.name: rl_email_day_window_hours
param.label: Email Day Window (hours)
param.description: Day email limiter window length in hours.

param.name: rl_email_day_max
param.label: Email Day Window Max
param.description: Maximum sends per email in the day window.

param.name: rl_resend_enabled
param.label: Resend Cooldown Enabled
param.description: Enable or disable resend cooldown limiting.

param.name: rl_resend_cooldown_sec
param.label: Resend Cooldown (seconds)
param.description: Minimum delay between resend requests for the same email.

param.name: rl_attempts_enabled
param.label: Attempts Limit Enabled
param.description: Enable or disable failed verification attempt limiting.

param.name: rl_attempts_max
param.label: Failed Attempts Max
param.description: Maximum failed code submissions per email in the active attempt window.
